    AI Overview
    Luke Murray (born c. 1985) is the son of actor Bill Murray and his first wife, Margaret Kelly. He is a highly successful college basketball coach, recently hired as the head coach for Boston College in March 2026 after serving as a key assistant coach for two national championship teams at UConn. 
    Key Details About Luke Murray: 
    • Coaching Career: Luke has extensive experience as an assistant coach, with previous roles at Louisville, Xavier, Towson, Wagner, Arizona, Post, and Quinnipiac before his success at UConn.
    • Relationship with Bill: Luke is frequently seen at games with his father, who has been a visible supporter of his career.
    • Background: He attended St. Luke's School in New Canaan, Connecticut, and graduated from Fairfield University in 2007, says Wikipedia.
    • Hiring: He was hired by Boston College to lead their basketball program in March 2026, marking his first head coaching position, according to AP News. 
    Bill Murray has other sons (Homer, Jackson, Caleb, Cooper), but Luke is prominently known for his college basketball coaching career.
